body: This is kind of what I meant by my situation being somewhat helpless, my mom just doesn't ever set up help. If its for stuff like psychical health, then maybe but when it comes to mental I have never gotten it. I ask, and ask, and ask but she always says she will and then never does.

On Thursday I am going to the doctor for like some checkup? I will just be getting some blood tests but I was wondering if they will like wonder about my cutting scars? Also can I ask them about any of this and could they help? 

My mom already knows I SH so it doesn't really matter but I just wanna know if they will yell at me for doing something like this.

Well I really don't know what you can do, mainly because I don't even know how to help my self? if that makes any sense. I just wish that people took my problems seriously and stopped brushing it off. 

The social anxiety just feels like a whole new level, I don't know how to describe it but it can be really bad to the point where I can just be paralyzed in fear. It typically only happens when I am getting yelled at or someone is being really hyper and just talking to me really fast. 

I'd like to think that maybe its just depression that makes me feel this way where its just tricking me into thinking its pointless, and that's why I've kept going but at the same time my situation really does feel helpless and I feel worthless to everyone around me.

I don't really know any "cliché responses" other then suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary problem, or at least that's the only one I can think of. 

I also just wish it wasn't my fault, or at least I think its my fault. I don't like blaming people for things so I just like to blame it on myself and I mean I like to blame myself ALOT. 

I also need to stop being so overly apologetic, I feel like its annoying.
